readerCopy.body: Anger becomes more useful when it reveals the request, rule, or expectation that has stopped being tolerable. When Mars conjoins Lilith, action and refusal fuse, making a long-suppressed no much harder to keep smiling through. There may be much less patience for a demand, assumption, or boundary violation that has already gone too far. The reaction can be larger than the immediate offense because the immediate offense is not the whole pattern. The strongest use of the anger is the boundary that changes participation in the problem instead of turning the entire arrangement into a fight.
